contexts.text: The things remaining (of the Most Ancient Church) were not of perception, but of integrity.
Noah was a man just and perfect in his generations ()... Just regards the good of charity; perfect, the truth of charity.

Perfect = the truth which is from charity; for truth exists from many other origins, but that which is from the good of charity from the Lord is called perfect, and the man a perfect man; as in... He that walketh perfectly... (). Here is described one who is perfect... With the perfect man Thou wilt show Thyself perfect (); where it treats of the perfect man, who is such from the Holy or good of charity... Jehovah will not prohibit good to them that walk in integrity ().

That the perfect = him who is true from good, or who speaks and does what is true from charity, is evident from the fact that there are many times applied to perfect, or integrity, the words walk. and way; and also right, or rectitude; which words belong to truth; as in David: I will inform the perfect in the way... I will walk in the integrity of my heart... ()... Blessed are the perfect in the way, who walk in the Law of Jehovah ()... Mark the perfect, and behold the right... (). From these passages it is evident that he is called just who does what is good; and that he is called perfect who does the truth thence derived; which also is to do justice and judgment. Holiness and justice are the Celestial of faith; integrity and judgment are the Spiritual thence derived.
Just = the good of charity; perfect the truth of charity. References.
They say that in Adam there was the image of God, which they say was a certain integrity... There really was an integrity; for by Adam is meant the Most Ancient Church...
He who is in charity from the Lord is in integrity; of which integrity... in what follows.
Serve Him in integrity and truth... (). AC 1992:2.

Be thou perfect () = the good of charity. Perfect = to do what is good from truth; that is, good from the conscience of truth, thus from charity, for this makes conscience... But as the Lord is treated of, by perfect is signified the good of charity; for good proceeds from charity, insomuch that the truth itself which is thence is good.
Before these two are conjoined, the man cannot be a whole man.
Rectitude, in the Original Language, is expressed by a word which means also integrity and perfection...
God healed Abimelech = the wholeness of doctrine as to good... His wife also is said to be healed, by which is signified the wholeness of doctrine as to truth.
Integrity () is predicated of the good of faith; and Truth of the truth of faith.
Not even the man who, from the integrity in which he was, was called the likeness and image of God.
Jacob was a perfect man () = truth... Perfect is predicated of those who are in truth, thus of truth. References.
With the Most Ancients, whose age was called golden, because they lived in a certain state of integrity...
For the men of the Most Ancient Church had a Voluntary in which there was what is integral or entire.

The Most Ancient Church was celestial, because with them there was something entire (or perfect) in their voluntary part; but the Ancient Church... was spiritual, because with them there was not anything entire (or perfect) in the voluntary part, but in the intellectual part.
With him the understanding and the will made one mind... Herein consisted the integrity (or undiminished perfection) of the first man...

They called those times the Golden Age when there were innocence and integrity... They called those times the Silver Age when there was no longer innocence, but still a species of integrity; which did not consist in their doing good from good, but in their doing truth from truth.
A lamb without blemish () = unspotted innocence... Without blemish = without a fault, thus unspotted.
Ye shall not break a bone in it = that scientific truth also shall be entire.

The Scientific is said to be entire when it admits into itself nothing except the truths which agree with their good; for the Scientific is the general receptacle. Moreover, scientifics are like the bones in man. If these are not entire, or in their order, as when they are out of joint, or when distorted, the form of the body is varied, and its actions accordingly thereto.
It is otherwise in our Earth, where Divine truth, which is the Word, remains in its integrity in perpetuity.

One solid of pure gold = entire and perfect because from the same good... For that which is wholly from good is entire and perfect. By what is wholly from good, and thus by what is entire and perfect, is meant when good is the all in all...

Thummim, in the Hebrew language, is integrity; but in the angelic language, a shining forth... The like is perceived by the Angels when Thum is read in the Hebrew language, by which is meant what is entire, or integrity. Hence it is that by entire in the internal sense of the Word, is signified Divine truth in effect, which is a life according to the Divine precepts. Illustrated.
Hence it is that... these Books (of the Old Testament) have been preserved entire even to a jot...
By sincerity are also meant integrity, justice, etc.
The spiritual mind... is preserved in its integrity by the Lord, in order that man may be able to become man...
Hence it is, that with man there is nothing entire, but that he is wholly evil.

They are in an enormous error who believe that Adam was wise and did good from himself, and that this was his state of integrity... For he then fell from his state of integrity, which he had from the fact that he believed himself to be wise and to do good from God... AE 774:6.

The changes of state (with men and women) are to integrate their forms; the intellectual form with the men, and the voluntary form with the women... With both, however, the external form which is of the body is integrated according to the integration of the internal form which is of the mind.
You know nothing about the primeval state of man, which you call a state of integrity. Explained.
That without this Redemption... no Angel could subsist in a state of integrity. General article. TCR 119. TCR 579.
This relation causest that all things of the universe have been preserved in their integrity...
Integrity, see Perfection.
If the inhabitants of Mars did not remain in their state, which with us is called the state of integrity, others would succeed from a new Earth who would be like them.
Such would have become the men and sons of the Most Ancient Church, if they had remained in the state of integrity (or perfection), as it is called.
When men were as it were in a state of integrity, the natural operation... of the cerebellum, was shown at once in the whole face...
This signified those of the inhabitants of Mars, who now, by little and little, begin to decline from the state of perfection, as people call it.
With these, there at last remains not anything entire.
To shoot in secret places at the perfect () = ... to cheat those who are in truths from good.
Mark the perfect, and see the right... ... The perfect... is said in the Word of good; and the right... of truth.
The Lord knoweth the days of the perfect (). The days of the perfect = the states of those who are in good and the derivative truths, or who are in charity and the derivative faith.
Therefore the altar was made... of whole stones, upon which iron had not been moved... The reason it was made of whole stones, was that these stones = truths formed from good, or good in form...
That nothing from Own intelligence should accede to the truths of doctrine and the derivative worship, and consequently be in it, was represented by the stones being whole and not cut...
The integrity (of Adam) consisted in a fuller reception of good and truth, and thence of intelligence and wisdom from the Lord, than that of his descendants...
He that walketh perfectly = him who is in good as to life, and in truths as to doctrine.
They who believe that the Angels were created... in such a state of integrity that they could do good of themselves, is very much mistaken...
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it () = that both natural and spiritual things... are destroyed.
Trinity. 10. 4. Therefore, unless a New Church had been established by the Lord, which has restored both the Church and the Word to its integrity, no flesh could be preserved.
